items.title: Ethiopia: Food Shortages Hit 71 Percent of Ethiopian Families Displaced Into Kenya's Moyale
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Tens of thousands of people who fled escalating conflict in Moyale along Ethiopia's border between Oromia and Somali regional states and crossed into northern Kenya are facing acute food shortages, inadequate shelter and limited access to clean water and healthcare, according to a new assessment by the International Organization for Migration (IOM) and humanitarian partners.

items.title: Twenty-two Somali students in Italy on MAECI scholarships
items.description: (ANSA) - NAIROBI, 10 NOV - The Italian Ambassador to Mogadishu, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi, together with his entire staff, welcomed the young recipients of scholarships for the 2026–2027 academic year offered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation. items.description: For years, international partners have helped Somalia fight Al-Shabaab, train troops and strengthen its security institutions. items.titleIt: Editorial: Somalia's Security Dilemma: Can a Nation Dependent on Foreign Forces Defend Itself?

items.title: UN Ends Three Decades of Political Mission in Somalia
items.description: The closure of the U.N. Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNTMIS) follows a two-year transition agreed with the federal government. Its responsibilities have been transferred to Somali institutions and U.N. agencies. The mission's roots dates back to 1995, when the U.N. established its Political Office for Somalia. It was replaced by the U.N. Assistance Mission in Somalia (UNSOM) in 2013 before entering its final transition phase as UNTMIS in 2024. items.description: Multiple sources reported fierce clashes in the area, with initial accounts indicating significant losses among federal government forces. items.titleIt: Somali forces report heavy fighting near Burhakaba as airstrike claims denied

items.description: Former president Shariif Sheikh Ahmed criticized the incumbent president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of seeking to retain power unlawfully. items.titleIt: Somalia Opposition leaders reject 2027 election timetable
